what: R129 air control and landing tiers (P1-FL07; docs/research/fun-tracks.md R14-R16) on the Feel Lab's canyon leap: a Cruz Missile takes the kicker flat out down its middle at 22 m/s, lifts off the throttle at the lip (tick 66) and flies the gap; it floors it again once down (tick 260). The three fixtures fly the same jump three ways (air-pitch-neutral, -down, -up). Neutral: no input in the air holds the lip's nose-up attitude, so it lands in the OK band (8-25 degrees to the landing): no boost, no loss. Its speed 0.75 s after landing is the reference the other two beat or lose to (the run-out is downhill, so it gains a little).
